entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hello Diana. I need to start a return for an order I received about a week and a half ago.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Great, thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Shield Helmet. What specifically is the issue with it?
There's no issue with the helmet itself, but the color is much brighter in person than it looked online. It doesn't match the rest of my gear.
I see. So it's more of a style preference. Is the item still in its original packaging?
Yes, absolutely. The box is unopened. I knew right away it wasn't going to work for me.

Understood. Getting the right gear is important. Let me just confirm our policy... Okay, yes, it was delivered 10 days ago, so you are well within our 90-day return window. I've just approved the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file.

That's great, thank you. I appreciate how easy that was. Say, since I am sending this one back and plan to order a different model, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? Just to cover the hassle.

I understand you're looking for the best value on your next purchase. For a return based on color preference, I'm not able to generate a discount code. However, your refund will be processed as soon as the item is back in our warehouse, and you can use that to purchase the correct helmet. We want to make sure you have the perfect gear for your safety.
Okay, that's fair. I figured it was worth asking. I'll keep an eye out for that email. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all for me. Have a good day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
